countryNote: Showing the {n} largest development partners by 2024 CRS-reported spend in the Health & Population sector (CRS purpose codes 12000–14000) — the scope already analysed in the IATI/CRS coverage methodology. Coverage (2024) is each partner's IATI net spend as a share of their CRS reference spend for the same year, and can exceed 100% (e.g. due to timing or exchange-rate differences). Timeliness and "spend covered" are calculated only across the partners shown and exclude domestic government spending; timeliness reflects each publisher's most recent reporting frequency on the IATI dashboard, and coverage is always assessed against 2024 CRS figures regardless of the ranking column selected above.
